primary.title: Missed declaring FD income last year? Here's how you can rectify it and what happens if you ignore it
primary.summary: Fixed deposits offer safe, assured returns but are taxable under income tax laws. Taxpayers who missed declaring FD interest can file an updated return (ITR-U) within four years, allowing for corrections with varying additional tax penalties based on the filing time. Details here.
